case_name: Bimala Malo vs The State Of Assam And 10 Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Bimala Malo, W/O- LATE GOBINDA CHANDRA MALO
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Assam and 10 Ors

facts_of_case: Petitioner claiming grant of family pension payable to her in view of services rendered by her late husband Govinda Chandra Malo, who was working as an Assistant Teacher.

legal_principles.principle: The pension proposal could not be prepared and proceeded with in absence of a valid 'Next of kin certificate'.
legal_principles.held: The stand of the Department before this Court reflects that the pension proposal could not be prepared and proceeded with in absence of a valid 'Next of kin certificate' which is to be furnished by the petitioner or the respondent no.11.
cited_cases: Mustt Junufa Bibi vs Mustt Padma Begum @ Padma Bibi & 4 Ors., (2022) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The law regarding the claim of family pension by the second wife is well settled.
legal_principles.held: The law regarding the claim of family pension by the second wife is well settled by judgment of a Full Bench of this Court rendered on 22.12.2022 in Mustt Junufa Bibi vs Mustt Padma Begum @ Padma Bibi & 4 Ors.
cited_cases: Mustt Junufa Bibi vs Mustt Padma Begum @ Padma Bibi & 4 Ors., (2022) X SCC Y
